annotations.title: ESPD / DGUE European Exclusion Grounds & Self-Cleaning Screener

description:
[ESPD / DGUE European exclusion grounds & self-cleaning screener. Pure statutory calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Audits economic operator eligibility under Directive 2014/24/EU Article 57, checking mandatory exclusion grounds, discretionary misconduct, and Article 57(6) self-cleaning measures.
Usage: Use this tool to verify bidder compliance with ESPD/DGUE declaration requirements and evaluate whether self-cleaning rehabilitation measures are legally sufficient.
Returns: JSON object with { operatorName: string, isEligibleToParticipate: boolean, verdictStatus: string, mandatoryBreachesFound: array, selfCleaningAudit: object, economicCapacityAudit: object }.
